name: J.A.K.Q. Dengekitai
description: Cyborg warriors were created by the Special Science Investigation Squad to bear nuclear, gravitational, magnetic, and electrical forces. They fight the crime empire known as "Crime".

videos.overview: The Gorangers must team up with J.A.K.Q. to stop Iron Claw and his generals from bombing the Earth's major countries
